Taylor Green: Heads-up — SilverCrest shows 0 inference calls last 3 days. Renewal ~4w. Token usage was steady (~12k/day) until 3/18. Flagging for renewal triage.
Ben Morales: Yikes. Any idea if the champion is still engaged? I heard procurement is evaluating OrionAI.
Maya Lin: Quick check: SR-9142 shows repeated 401s from their app after a recent IdP rotation. No 5xx from our side. Uploading ticket notes to /shared/silvercrest/SR-9142.txt.
Omar Khan: Procurement asked for latencies + SLA examples during the Orion demo. They want baseline p95 and failover behavior.
Taylor Green: Proposed play: 1) send IP-restricted short-lifespan token so devs can unblock tests, 2) offer 25k free tokens + 30-min SE perf tune, 3) schedule 20-min security/integration sync. Thoughts? :+1:
Ben Morales: Agree. I'll draft a 1-page TCO + SLA bullets for procurement. Loop legal if they ask contract changes.
Maya Lin: Also adding a 3-step SAML checklist and a tiny warmup curl they can drop into their init job:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/run -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"warmup","max_tokens":1}'
Taylor Green: @Omar can you own scheduling? I'll lead the call and push the free token + SE session. If usage doesn't resume within 8 days after the call, escalate to AE for exec outreach.
ops-bot: SR-9142 linked to renewal task RC-220. Priority set to HIGH by Taylor Green.
Omar Khan: Scheduled call for Thu 10:30am PT. Invites sent to SilverCrest security and procurement. Keeping thread updated.
